impeach: fixture app order-level discount, rename line_subtotal to line_total

compute_total gains a discount parameter: a currency amount off the whole
order, applied before tax and floored at zero. Threaded through checkout
(payload "discount" key) and quote (keyword arg); both default to
undiscounted, so existing callers are unaffected.

line_subtotal is renamed to line_total, with its two call sites updated
(app/api.py, tests/test_service.py).

refund_amount calls compute_total positionally and keeps its behaviour.
Whether a refund should account for the order discount is a product
question, left alone deliberately.

Verified with tests/test_api.py only, 8 passed. tests/test_service.py was
edited for the rename and the new discount cases but not run.
